analysis.purpose: The Rust extractor: turns one Rust file into symbol nodes (mod, struct, enum, trait, impl, fn, method, associated fn, type alias, macro) with qualified names, spans and signatures, plus member-of edges and intra-file call edges — never resolving anything across file boundaries.
responsibilities: Emit a symbol per declaration with qualifiedName, span and signature
Emit member-of edges linking each symbol to its enclosing symbol or file
Emit calls edges only where the callee resolves inside the same file
Stay deterministic and offline so a cold install needs no network

businessRules.rule: The extractor never guesses across files; imports, cross-file calls and inheritance are the resolver phase job.
businessRules.rationale: Capability honesty — a guess made here would be indistinguishable from a fact downstream.
